description: Panel built only from yfinance tickers that still resolve on Yahoo. Delisted/merged names whose ticker was retired are absent (DHFL, KWALITY, GRUH, MINDTREE, HDFC, ANDHRABANK, CORPBANK, VIJAYABANK, CADILAHC all MISSING). Only 136/2831 symbols end >90d before panel end vs many hundreds of real NSE delistings over 15y.
evidence: probe of 24 known-dead tickers: 8 MISSING; monotonic symbol growth 683(2005)->2707(2026)
potential_backtest_impact: Backtest long-only results biased UP: losers that went to zero/merged are invisible; winners over-represented
recommended_fix: Acquire point-in-time delisted history (bhavcopy full archive already downloaded in data/raw; or paid vendor). Build symbol master keyed on ISIN. Include delisted series with terminal price.

description: Incremental daily update (scripts/yf_daily_update.py) refetches only last 4 days; parquet upsert keep=last. yfinance re-scales full-history Adj Close on every new dividend/split, but stored history is NOT refetched -> adjustment-basis drift/discontinuity between old history and new bars.
evidence: yfinance_adjusted.py close=adj_close, ratio recomputed per-fetch-window; update start=end-4d
affected_rows: all symbols after any split since last full backfill
potential_backtest_impact: Artificial price jumps -> false breakout signals / false stops at split boundaries
recommended_fix: Full re-backfill on any split/large-dividend, or store raw OHLC + apply a maintained cumulative-adjustment-factor table; never rely on incremental Adj Close.

description: Back-adjustment produces absurd values: 110 rows with >10x single-day gains (SEJALLTD 3369x @2009-12-03, AQYLON 2440x, close values >Rs17000-41000 for penny stocks). Splits applied to near-zero raw prices.
potential_backtest_impact: Pollutes 52w-high, SMA, RS-rank indicators; some survive liquidity filter
recommended_fix: Detect via split-ratio cross-check; cap/repair only from verified CA table; exclude corrupted symbol-windows

description: 4944 rows with negative or zero adjusted prices from over-adjustment (LEEL 2576 rows 2005-2017 negative; INDUSFILA 441; VALECHAENG 252).
potential_backtest_impact: NaN/negative feeds returns -> -inf returns, broken indicators
recommended_fix: Exclude these symbol-windows; refetch raw and re-derive adjustment

description: OHLC invariant violations: 6643 rows high<max(o,c,l), 7790 low>min(o,c,h), 3312 high<low. ~median rel-error 1e-16 (float rounding from ratio mult) but tail up to 17x = real broken rows. Concentrated pre-2012 (480-1310/yr) vs ~15/yr recent.
potential_backtest_impact: Minor for recent data; early-period indicators unreliable

description: 6.16% of rows have zero volume (479287); 38641 zero-volume rows show a price change (impossible); 8.3% of rows repeat prior close (stale). No forward-fill in code but absence of a session != no-trade is not distinguished.
potential_backtest_impact: Illiquid/non-traded days treated as tradable; unrealistic fills
recommended_fix: Add per-date tradability flag (volume>0 & not circuit-locked); enforce min traded-value at execution

description: turnover = raw_close*raw_volume (unadjusted) while OHLC are dividend+split adjusted -> internally inconsistent; ratio turnover/(adjclose*vol) spans 1.0-1.07+ with +/-inf on bad rows. Volume is split-adjusted only (not dividend).
potential_backtest_impact: adv50 liquidity filter mixes adjusted price with raw turnover basis
recommended_fix: Document; compute a single consistent traded-value; recompute adv on adjusted basis

description: Two different benchmarks: regime_gate uses NIFTYBEES (Nifty50 ETF, price return, tracking error); performance comparison uses Nifty500 TRI. close=Adj Close so strategy trades a dividend-adjusted (total-return-ish) series -> vs TRI is fair on dividends, but universe (broad/midcap) != Nifty500 and regime benchmark != comparison benchmark.
potential_backtest_impact: Benchmark comparison partially apples-to-oranges (index breadth); regime signal uses a different index than reported alpha
recommended_fix: Use consistent Nifty500 TRI for both regime and comparison; document dividend treatment

description: 5552 weekend rows - MOSTLY legitimate NSE special sessions (Budget Saturdays 2015-02-28, 2025-02-01; Diwali Muhurat 2020-11-14, 2019-10-27 Sun). A few may be tz artifacts.
recommended_fix: Cross-check against official NSE special-session list

description: No point-in-time index membership. nifty500_constituents.csv is a single current snapshot (500 rows). Backtest avoids this by using a DYNAMIC liquidity universe (adv50/vol50/min_price as-of date, engine.py _eligible_universe) - which is unbiased in construction - BUT it draws from the survivorship-biased panel (DQ-001), so PIT-ness is undermined by missing delisted names.
evidence: _eligible_universe uses trailing adv50; nifty500 csv=1 snapshot
potential_backtest_impact: Dynamic universe is methodologically sound; bias enters via missing symbols upstream
recommended_fix: Keep dynamic universe; fix DQ-001 to feed it delisted names

description: No ISIN, series, exchange, listing_date, delisting_date, or sector in the price panel. Symbol identity purely by NSE ticker string -> renamed tickers (MINDTREE->LTIM, CADILAHC->ZYDUSLIFE) appear as separate/lost securities; no ISIN continuity.
potential_backtest_impact: Symbol renames break continuity; splits history across two tickers or lose pre-rename data
recommended_fix: Build ISIN-keyed security master with rename effective dates

description: No dataset manifest/checksums/version. Panel rebuilt by re-hitting yfinance (non-deterministic: adj values drift over time, tickers disappear). No immutable raw snapshot of yfinance pulls retained.
potential_backtest_impact: Dataset not reproducible; a re-pull yields different numbers
recommended_fix: Snapshot raw pulls to immutable storage + manifest (version, date_range, row/symbol counts, code commit)
